mapper.select: select ro.id, ro.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_type, o.pay_amount, ro.refund_amount, ro.refund_reason, ro.refund_status, ro.remark, ro.audit_time, ro.refund_time, ro.create_time from refund_order ro join t_order o on ro.order_id = o.id where o.user_id = #{userId} order by ro.id desc

select ro.id, ro.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_type, o.pay_amount, ro.refund_amount, ro.refund_reason, ro.refund_status, ro.remark, ro.audit_time, ro.refund_time, ro.create_time from refund_order ro join t_order o on ro.order_id = o.id where exists ( select 1 from order_item oi join product p on oi.product_id = p.id where oi.order_id = ro.order_id and p.create_user_id = #{userId} ) order by ro.id desc
